citations.title: Commerce SQL aggregate: Inventory allocation
citations.sql_query: SELECT i.snapshot_date, i.category, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.stockout_flag = TRUE) AS stockout_count, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.overstock_flag = TRUE) AS overstock_count FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = '2022-12-31' GROUP BY i.snapshot_date, i.category LIMIT 100

citations.title: Commerce schema/data coverage: Inventory allocation
citations.excerpt: Yearly stockout_snapshots count inventory rows flagged stockout, not distinct stockout incidents. Latest category stockout_products and overstock_products are overlapping flag counts, not disjoint stock pools. The separate latest-snapshot overlap aggregate reports how many rows carry both flags; none of these category aggregates establishes transferable surplus or justifies shifting inventory between categories.
